sources.title: CDC STEADI Timed Up & Go assessment
sources.short_quote: An older adult who takes ≥12 seconds to complete the TUG is at risk for falling.
sources.application: Use an explicitly recorded test duration and compatible protocol to nominate dated source review. This does not estimate an individual's fall probability or determine a service.

sources.title: Medicare home health services
sources.short_quote: You must need part-time or intermittent skilled services
sources.application: Homebound criteria, an appropriate skilled need, provider evaluation and orders, and a certified agency require separate verification. Medicare Advantage requires exact plan checks. A mobility observation or support request does not establish coverage.

review_configuration.age_boundary_authority: Conservative older-adult development screen; the quoted TUG sheet says older adult without a numeric age. Not an independently validated eligibility criterion.
accepted_source_protocols: rise from chair, walk three metres, turn, return and sit
rise, walk three metres, turn, return and sit using usual aid

unimplemented_requirements: Current clinical assessment and test quality
Homebound and skilled-service criteria when applicable
Exact plan, service date, network, authorization and agency availability
Clinical orders and accountable review before execution
limits: Source dates are not automatically clinical event dates or current status.
The warehouse's future synthetic cutoff does not establish future guideline or benefit validity.
No source signal is not a negative clinical finding; the selected categories do not cover the whole chart.
Boolean fields retain their literal values; false is not rewritten as not assessed, no need, or ineligible.
